chapters.title: The Opportunity

chapters.argument: LOA may have a memorable bottle, but it has not yet proved the specific occasion, reason to choose or route from first taste to profitable repeat.
chapters.decision: Reject this diagnosis if founder, customer and cohort evidence already shows a clear occasion, strong unprompted proposition recall and profitable repeat without increased discounting.
chapters.title: The Constraint

chapters.argument: LOA could turn its coral bottle and optimistic visual language into a recognisable adult soft-drink ritual: a brighter pour for social pauses that deserve more than water and less than alcohol.
chapters.decision: Compare A Brighter Pour with taste-led, wellness-led and alcohol-alternative routes on relevance, distinctiveness, credibility, recall and willingness to pay.
chapters.title: The Advantage

chapters.argument: Give LOA one ownable social job, make the bright-pour ritual unmistakable, then connect selective trial to measured repeat before buying reach.
chapters.decision: Approve only the next tests, not the modelled revenue outcome.

recommendations.action: Define and test LOA around the moments when adults want a vivid, grown-up soft drink without making an unverified health or alcohol-replacement claim.
recommendations.name: Own the brighter pause
recommendations.test: Founder interview, occasion research and controlled proposition test
recommendations.trade_off: A sharper occasion excludes generic refreshment traffic and must earn credibility.

recommendations.action: Use the bottle, serve, sound, colour and food pairing as recurring evidence of the occasion rather than relying on abstract lifestyle imagery.
recommendations.name: Make the pour the proof
recommendations.test: Creative recognition, comprehension and qualified sample-to-site test
recommendations.trade_off: Product-centred work will reveal any weakness in taste, pack, serve or availability.

recommendations.action: Concentrate sampling and selective wholesale where repeat can be observed, then use DTC mixed cases and CRM replenishment to measure second purchase.
recommendations.name: Turn trial into repeat
recommendations.test: One-city cohort test of repeat and retailer sell-through
recommendations.trade_off: Geographic focus slows broad awareness while protecting cash and learning quality.
